hero.titleLine2: one single line at a time
hero.subtitle: Livestock, crops, stock, finances, clients — all centralized in one tool, from the henhouse to the accountant's desk.

features.title: What the software handles for you
features.subtitle: Every module feeds the others automatically: a recorded sale updates stock, finances, and the client's balance — no re-entry needed.

production.title: Production
production.description: Layer hens, Kuroiler, dairy cows, maize, rice, soy — one entry per day, a complete history.

stock.title: Stock
stock.description: Entries and exits tracked automatically. Alerted as soon as an item drops below the critical threshold.

finance.title: Finance
finance.description: Expenses and income categorized by activity. Profit calculates itself.

clients.title: Clients
clients.description: Purchase history, balances and debts kept up to date with every recorded payment.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: Invoicing, partial payments, credit — a cash journal that never lies.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Financial, production, stock. Export to PDF and Excel in one click.

offline.title: The network drops. The work goes on.
offline.subtitle: A worker in the henhouse or the field can log production even without a connection. Once the network is back, everything syncs by itself — nothing to redo, nothing lost.
offline.modeDescription: Entries stored locally, sent automatically once reconnected.
offline.langDescription: French, Malagasy and English for the whole team, from the field to the office.
offline.bannerDescription: The app stays usable, but your entries won't be synced yet.
